item.title: Under Princess
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: GearProducts
  • 発売日: 2001-09-21
  • スコア: 5.92/10 (10 人評価)
  • 日本語名: アンダープリンセス
  • 英語名: Under Princess

别名

  • マルチシナリオアドベンチャー Tails Tale（テイルズテイル）

あらすじ

Youichi learns about English architecture. One day, he goes to the underground to do some research. Dank and fetid…, suddenly he is struck by a flash flood. He somehow escapes into a cave, and loses his consciousness. When he wakes up, there is a woman looking down at him. Her name is Anrietta, who has been confined in the basement since she was a girl, and insulted by men every day. He decides to save her in return for what she did to him….
